description: This file contains PHP code that implements client-side API interactions with a TestLink server via XML-RPC. It provides functions to create test projects, test plans, builds, and platforms, utilizing the IXR_Client class to communicate with the server.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: A class used for creating XML-RPC client requests to communicate with the TestLink server.

methods.name: createTestProject
methods.description: Creates a new test project on the TestLink server using XML-RPC.

methods.name: createTestPlan
methods.description: Creates a new test plan within a specific test project.

methods.name: createBuild
methods.description: Creates a new build associated with a test plan.

methods.name: createPlatform
methods.description: Creates multiple platform entries for a test project.
